items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: You'd be there on time, ready to play. Dink come there and take him a half an hour to set up his drum.

ctx.x: Yeah, he named it that. That's the time him and Dink fell out. I'm trying to remember the drummer we had. He wouldn't let Dink play for him no more.
